blocks.zh: 第三部分4–6節：系統覆蓋範圍、品質系統與廠房設備系統
blocks.en: Part 3, Sections 4-6: System Coverage, Quality System, and Facilities and Equipment System

blocks.zh: 📋 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: 📋 Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握品質系統查廠的兩階段評估架構（程序審查 + 數據趨勢評估）
blocks.en: Understand the two-phase evaluation framework for quality system inspections (procedure review + data trend evaluation)

blocks.zh: 識別 FDA 在品質系統查廠中必審的四大類記錄（投訴/偏差/趨勢/變更控制）
blocks.en: Identify the four categories of records FDA must review in a quality system inspection (complaints / deviations / trends / change control)

blocks.zh: 了解廠房設備系統查廠的兩層評估邏輯（設計合理性 + 控制狀態數據）
blocks.en: Understand the two-layer evaluation logic for facilities and equipment system inspections (design soundness + state-of-control data)

blocks.zh: 掌握各類無菌製程設備（Sterilizer、Lyophilizer、Isolator、RABS、BFS）的 FDA 查廠重點
blocks.en: Know FDA's inspection focus for each type of sterile process equipment (sterilizer, lyophilizer, isolator, RABS, BFS)

blocks.zh: 理解 Isolator 與 RABS 的去污驗證要求（6-log BI reduction）
blocks.en: Understand the decontamination validation requirement for isolators and RABS (6-log BI reduction)

blocks.zh: 3.4 System Inspection Coverage 系統查廠覆蓋範圍
blocks.en: 3.4 System Inspection Coverage

blocks.zh: 📘 系統覆蓋架構解讀
blocks.en: 📘 Interpreting the System Coverage Framework

blocks.zh: 兩層指引的關係
blocks.en: How the Two Guidance Documents Relate

blocks.zh: CP 7356.002（母計畫）提供通用六系統查廠架構；CP 7356.002A（本文件）在此基礎上提供無菌製程特有的補充要求。兩份文件必須搭配使用——母計畫設定基線，本文件提高無菌製程標準。
blocks.en: CP 7356.002 (the parent program) provides the general six-system inspection framework; CP 7356.002A (this document) adds requirements specific to sterile processes on top of it. The two documents must be used together: the parent program sets the baseline, and this document raises the bar for sterile processing.

blocks.zh: 💡 Attachment A 的使用邏輯
blocks.en: 💡 How to Use Attachment A

blocks.zh: Attachment A 的問題清單是查廠輔助工具，不是強制清單。查廠官員可選擇性使用；答案不需一定記錄在 EIR 中，除非有缺失。藥廠可研讀這份清單來了解 FDA 的查廠思維，用於 mock inspection 設計。
blocks.en: The question list in Attachment A is an inspection aid, not a mandatory checklist. Investigators may use it selectively, and the answers need not be recorded in the EIR unless there is a deficiency. Firms can study the list to understand how FDA thinks about inspections and use it to design mock inspections.

blocks.zh: 3.5 Quality System 品質系統
blocks.en: 3.5 Quality System

blocks.zh: 📘 品質系統查廠解讀 — 數據驅動的兩階段評估
blocks.en: 📘 Interpreting the Quality System Inspection: A Data-Driven, Two-Phase Evaluation

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 最關鍵原則：「無論最終判定如何」都要調查
blocks.en: ⚠️ The Key Principle: Investigate "Regardless of the Final Outcome"

blocks.zh: FDA 明確要求：所有初次陽性無菌試驗（initial positive sterility test）、內毒素失敗和培養基模擬試驗失敗（media fill failure）必須調查記錄，無論最終批次是否放行。
blocks.en: FDA expressly requires that every initial positive sterility test, endotoxin failure, and media fill failure be investigated and documented, whether or not the batch is ultimately released.

blocks.zh: 這意味著即使實驗室最終判定為實驗室錯誤（Lab Error）並放行批次，該初次失敗仍需完整調查文件化。查廠時，未記錄的初次失敗是嚴重缺失。
blocks.en: This means that even if the laboratory ultimately concludes the result was a laboratory error and the batch is released, the initial failure still needs a fully documented investigation. During an inspection, an unrecorded initial failure is a serious deficiency.

blocks.zh: 💡 品質系統查廠的「偵探邏輯」
blocks.en: 💡 The "Detective Logic" of a Quality System Inspection

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠官員用品質系統數據來決定接下來要深查哪個生產系統。若 EM 趨勢顯示 Grade B 區域有持續超過 Alert Level 的情況，查廠官員就會深查廠房設備系統和生產系統。這是數據驅動的查廠策略。
blocks.en: FDA investigators use quality system data to decide which production system to examine in depth next. If EM trends show a Grade B area persistently exceeding the Alert Level, the investigator will go deeper into the facilities and equipment system and the production system. This is a data-driven inspection strategy.

blocks.zh: 🏭 品質系統查廠準備要點
blocks.en: 🏭 Key Preparation Points for a Quality System Inspection

blocks.zh: 準備完整的 Media Fill 摘要：包含上次查廠以來所有 APS 的批次、設計、結果
blocks.en: Prepare a complete media fill summary: all APS runs since the last inspection, with their batches, design, and results

blocks.zh: EM 趨勢報告：依區域、菌種分類，顯示趨勢線，說明 Alert/Action Level 設定依據
blocks.en: EM trend reports: broken down by area and organism, showing trend lines and explaining the basis for Alert/Action Level settings

blocks.zh: 初次失敗調查清單：所有初次陽性無菌試驗記錄，包含調查結論和處置
blocks.en: List of initial failure investigations: all initial positive sterility test records, including investigation conclusions and dispositions

blocks.zh: 關鍵設備變更清單：Sterilizer、WFI、HVAC 的所有變更及驗證文件
blocks.en: List of critical equipment changes: all changes to sterilizers, WFI, and HVAC, with the supporting validation documents

blocks.zh: 水系統趨勢報告：WFI、PW 的 TOC、電導度、微生物計數趨勢
blocks.en: Water system trend reports: trends in TOC, conductivity, and microbial counts for WFI and PW

blocks.zh: 兩階段評估的深層邏輯
blocks.en: The Deeper Logic of the Two-Phase Evaluation

blocks.zh: FDA 近年查廠更強調 Phase 2——有 SOP 但沒有有效的數據分析系統，仍屬重大缺失。
blocks.en: In recent years FDA has placed more emphasis on Phase 2: having SOPs without an effective data analysis system is still a major deficiency.

blocks.zh: 3.6 Facilities and Equipment System 廠房與設備系統
blocks.en: 3.6 Facilities and Equipment System

blocks.zh: 📘 廠房系統解讀 — 動態確認是核心
blocks.en: 📘 Interpreting the Facilities System: Dynamic Confirmation Is the Core

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 動態條件下的煙霧測試（Smoke Study）
blocks.en: ⚠️ Smoke Studies Under Dynamic Conditions

blocks.zh: FDA 要求煙霧測試必須在動態條件（Dynamic Conditions）下進行——即有人員、設備運作、正常操作的情況下，而非靜態空調房間。
blocks.en: FDA requires smoke studies to be performed under dynamic conditions, that is, with personnel present, equipment running, and normal operations under way, rather than in an idle, air-conditioned room.

blocks.zh: 靜態條件的煙霧測試不足以代表實際操作時的氣流狀況。動態測試的目的是確認：在最壞操作情境下，Grade A 區域的單向氣流是否仍能有效保護暴露產品。
blocks.en: A smoke study under static conditions is not sufficient to represent the airflow during actual operations. The purpose of dynamic testing is to confirm that, under worst-case operating scenarios, the unidirectional airflow in the Grade A area still effectively protects exposed product.

blocks.zh: 💡 廠房施工期間的特別注意
blocks.en: 💡 Special Attention During Facility Construction

blocks.zh: 靠近潔淨室的施工活動（甚至翻牆、鑽孔）可能釋放大量真菌孢子。FDA 要求：施工結束後，必須通過適當的環境監控和 Media Fill 確認潔淨室恢復到可接受狀態，才能恢復生產。
blocks.en: Construction near a cleanroom (even breaking through walls or drilling) can release large numbers of fungal spores. FDA expects that, after construction ends, appropriate environmental monitoring and media fills confirm the cleanroom has returned to an acceptable state before production resumes.

blocks.zh: 「設計合理性 + 控制數據」的雙層評估
blocks.en: A Two-Layer Evaluation: "Design Soundness + Control Data"

blocks.zh: FDA 不只看「廠房設計是否符合規格」，更要看「設計是否有風險科學依據」，以及「日常運行數據是否顯示系統處於受控狀態」。
blocks.en: FDA looks not only at whether the facility design meets specifications, but also at whether the design has a risk-based, scientific rationale and whether routine operating data show the system to be in a state of control.

blocks.zh: 3.6B Equipment — Key Equipment Inspection Points 設備查廠重點
blocks.en: 3.6B Equipment: Key Equipment Inspection Points

blocks.zh: (e) Sterilizers（高壓滅菌器 / 乾熱設備）
blocks.en: (e) Sterilizers (autoclaves / dry heat equipment)

blocks.zh: (f) Lyophilizer（凍乾機）
blocks.en: (f) Lyophilizer (freeze dryer)

blocks.zh: (g) Isolators（隔離器）
blocks.en: (g) Isolators

blocks.zh: (h) RABS（限制進入屏障系統）
blocks.en: (h) RABS (Restricted Access Barrier Systems)

blocks.zh: 📘 設備查廠解讀 — 各設備的核心風險
blocks.en: 📘 Interpreting the Equipment Inspection: Core Risks by Equipment Type

blocks.zh: Sterilizer — 重複滅菌是危險信號
blocks.en: Sterilizer: Repeat Sterilization Is a Red Flag

blocks.zh: FDA 特別指出：因循環失敗而重複滅菌（repeat sterilization）可能表示設備有嚴重問題。查廠官員會：
blocks.en: FDA specifically notes that repeat sterilization after a cycle failure may indicate a serious equipment problem. Investigators will:

blocks.zh: 審查設備日誌中的循環失敗記錄
blocks.en: Review cycle failure records in the equipment logbook

blocks.zh: 評估重複滅菌對產品品質的影響
blocks.en: Assess the impact of repeat sterilization on product quality

blocks.zh: 確認相關調查和 CAPA
blocks.en: Confirm the related investigation and CAPA

blocks.zh: 藥廠應建立循環失敗 = 偏差調查的自動觸發機制。
blocks.en: Firms should establish a mechanism under which a cycle failure automatically triggers a deviation investigation.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ Lyophilizer — 最危險的轉移步驟
blocks.en: ⚠️ Lyophilizer: The Highest-Risk Transfer Step

blocks.zh: 凍乾瓶（半塞狀態）從填充線轉移到凍乾機這段時間是風險最高的暴露期。FDA 查廠官員會實際觀察這個操作，確認：
blocks.en: The period when vials (in the partially stoppered state) are transferred from the filling line to the lyophilizer is the highest-risk exposure window. FDA investigators will actually observe this operation to confirm:

blocks.zh: 轉移過程全程在 ISO 5 保護下
blocks.en: The entire transfer takes place under ISO 5 protection

blocks.zh: 凍乾機裝載作業的人員技術和 SOP 執行
blocks.en: Operator technique and SOP execution during lyophilizer loading

blocks.zh: 凍乾機腔室在兩批之間的滅菌驗證
blocks.en: Sterilization validation of the lyophilizer chamber between batches

blocks.zh: Isolator 去污驗證要求（6-log BI）
blocks.en: Isolator Decontamination Validation Requirement (6-log BI)

blocks.zh: 要求：隔離器去污程序必須達到最低 6-log（百萬倍）生物指示劑（BI）殺滅率。
blocks.en: Requirement: the isolator decontamination procedure must achieve a minimum 6-log (one-million-fold) reduction of biological indicators (BI).

blocks.zh: 挑戰點：H₂O₂ 蒸氣等表面殺菌劑無法穿透被遮蔽或保護的表面（如螺絲縫隙、管道連接處）。驗證時必須在最壞情況位置放置 BI。
blocks.en: Challenge: surface sterilants such as H₂O₂ vapor cannot penetrate shielded or protected surfaces (such as screw crevices and pipe connections). During validation, BIs must be placed at worst-case locations.

blocks.zh: 實務要求：
blocks.en: Practical requirements:

blocks.zh: 量化測量裝置（如近紅外光）或化學指示劑確認最壞位置
blocks.en: Use quantitative measuring devices (such as near-infrared light) or chemical indicators to confirm worst-case locations

blocks.zh: 產品接觸表面需滅菌至無任何微生物（不僅僅是去污）
blocks.en: Product-contact surfaces must be sterilized until free of any microorganisms (not merely decontaminated)

blocks.zh: ⚠️ Open RABS 的陷阱：開門即失去 RABS 定義
blocks.en: ⚠️ The Open RABS Trap: Opening the Door Forfeits the RABS Definition

blocks.zh: FDA 明確指出：若門在填充作業中例行性開啟，該系統不再被視為 RABS（因為不再有效限制進入關鍵區域）。每次開門干預都必須：
blocks.en: FDA expressly states that if the doors are routinely opened during filling operations, the system is no longer considered a RABS (because it no longer effectively restricts access to the critical area). Every door-opening intervention must:

blocks.zh: 有書面程序定義允許的干預情境
blocks.en: Be covered by a written procedure defining the permitted intervention scenarios

blocks.zh: 記錄於批次記錄
blocks.en: Be recorded in the batch record

blocks.zh: 干預後執行消毒
blocks.en: Be followed by disinfection

blocks.zh: BFS — 空氣品質的直接關係
blocks.en: BFS: A Direct Link to Air Quality

blocks.zh: 研究顯示 BFS 污染單位數與周圍空氣微生物濃度有直接相關。因此：
blocks.en: Studies show that the number of contaminated BFS units is directly correlated with the airborne microbial concentration in the surroundings. Therefore:

blocks.zh: 產品暴露步驟（parison 形成、模具成型、填充）必須有 ISO 5 空氣品質
blocks.en: The product-exposure steps (parison formation, mold forming, filling) must have ISO 5 air quality

blocks.zh: 先進 BFS 設備可在 ISO 8 環境（降低廠房等級要求，節省成本）
blocks.en: Advanced BFS equipment can operate in an ISO 8 environment (lowering the facility grade requirement and saving cost)

blocks.zh: 產品供給管線通常採用 SIP（蒸氣就地滅菌），必須驗證且冷凝水需正確排放
blocks.en: The product supply line is usually sterilized by SIP (steam-in-place), which must be validated, and condensate must be drained properly

blocks.zh: 🏭 廠房設備系統查廠準備清單
blocks.en: 🏭 Facilities and Equipment System Inspection Preparation Checklist

blocks.zh: 潔淨室認證記錄：最近一次 HEPA 完整性測試、非活性粒子計數、壓差驗證
blocks.en: Cleanroom certification records: the most recent HEPA integrity test, non-viable particle counts, and pressure differential verification

blocks.zh: 煙霧測試記錄：確認在動態條件下執行；保存影像記錄
blocks.en: Smoke study records: confirm they were performed under dynamic conditions; retain the video records

blocks.zh: 消毒驗證：消毒劑有效期數據、輪替消毒劑的 VPHP/孢子殺菌劑效果驗證
blocks.en: Disinfection validation: disinfectant effectiveness (expiry) data, and efficacy validation of the rotated disinfectants and the VPHP/sporicidal agent

blocks.zh: Isolator/RABS 去污記錄：6-log BI 驗證資料、每批去污程序記錄
blocks.en: Isolator/RABS decontamination records: 6-log BI validation data and the decontamination cycle record for each batch

blocks.zh: 凍乾機裝載 SOP：確認有 ISO 5 保護記錄，操作人員訓練記錄
blocks.en: Lyophilizer loading SOP: confirm there are records of ISO 5 protection and operator training records

blocks.zh: 設備日誌：所有循環失敗記錄及調查文件
blocks.en: Equipment logbooks: all cycle failure records and investigation documents

blocks.zh: 水系統等距圖（Isometric Drawing）：需為最新版本
blocks.en: Water system isometric drawing: must be the current version

blocks.zh: 📌 本節重點摘要 Section Summary — 3.4–3.6
blocks.en: 📌 Section Summary: 3.4-3.6

blocks.zh: 品質系統兩階段：Phase 1（程序審查）+ Phase 2（數據趨勢評估）——後者是現代查廠的核心
blocks.en: Two phases of the quality system: Phase 1 (procedure review) + Phase 2 (data trend evaluation); the latter is the core of a modern inspection

blocks.zh: 必查記錄四類：產品投訴/ADE → 偏差/失敗調查 → EM/Media Fill 趨勢 → 關鍵設備變更控制
blocks.en: Four categories of records to review: product complaints/ADEs → deviation/failure investigations → EM/media fill trends → change control for critical equipment

blocks.zh: 初次失敗必查：無菌試驗初次陽性、Media Fill 失敗、內毒素失敗，無論最終判定均需調查文件
blocks.en: Initial failures must be reviewed: initial positive sterility tests, media fill failures, and endotoxin failures all require a documented investigation regardless of the final conclusion

blocks.zh: 廠房雙層評估：設計合理性（有科學依據） + 控制數據（日常監控有效）
blocks.en: Two-layer facility evaluation: design soundness (scientifically justified) + control data (routine monitoring is effective)

blocks.zh: 動態煙霧測試：必須在生產操作條件下執行，靜態不足
blocks.en: Dynamic smoke studies: must be performed under production operating conditions; static is not sufficient

blocks.zh: Isolator 6-log：去污驗證需達生物指示劑 6-log 殺滅率；注意穿透盲點
blocks.en: Isolator 6-log: decontamination validation must achieve a 6-log kill of biological indicators; watch for penetration blind spots

blocks.zh: RABS 開門原則：例行開門 = 失去 RABS 定義；每次干預必須記錄、消毒
blocks.en: RABS door-opening principle: routine door opening = loss of the RABS definition; every intervention must be recorded and followed by disinfection

blocks.zh: Lyophilizer 轉移：半塞瓶轉移至凍乾機全程需 ISO 5 保護；查廠官員可能觀察操作
blocks.en: Lyophilizer transfer: transfer of partially stoppered vials to the lyophilizer requires ISO 5 protection throughout; investigators may observe the operation

blocks.zh: BFS 空氣品質：所有暴露步驟需 ISO 5 空氣；空氣微生物濃度與污染率直接相關
blocks.en: BFS air quality: all exposure steps require ISO 5 air; airborne microbial concentration is directly correlated with contamination rate
